basis: Self-selected reading levels. Descriptions are adapted orientation aids; generation guides are app-authored and unvalidated.

de.beginner: I am starting out, or I can understand familiar words and short sentences about daily life with help.
de.intermediate: I can follow a short everyday story and connect events, although I still need help with some words and longer sentences.
de.advanced: I can follow detailed stories, viewpoints, and implied meaning, even when the vocabulary or sentence structure is unfamiliar.

ja.beginner: I can read hiragana and katakana. I am learning basic words and need support to understand short sentences and kanji.
ja.intermediate: I can follow a short everyday story in kana and some familiar kanji, using readings or a dictionary for unfamiliar words.
ja.advanced: I can follow detailed Japanese stories, viewpoints, and implied meaning, although unfamiliar kanji or expressions may still need support.

ru.beginner: I can read Cyrillic. I am learning basic words and need support to understand short everyday sentences.
ru.intermediate: I can follow a short everyday story in Cyrillic and connect events, although unfamiliar words and changing word endings can slow me down.
ru.advanced: I can follow detailed Russian stories, viewpoints, and implied meaning, even when unfamiliar expressions or complex sentences need support.

es-CL.beginner: I am starting out, or I can understand familiar Spanish words and short sentences about daily life with help.
es-CL.intermediate: I can follow a short everyday story and connect events, although unfamiliar words and longer sentences can slow me down.
es-CL.advanced: I can follow detailed Spanish stories, viewpoints, and implied meaning, although unfamiliar expressions may still need support.

de.beginner: Short, concrete scenes with familiar everyday words and simple present-tense sentences.
de.intermediate: Everyday situations with connected sentences, common past forms, and some subordinate clauses.
de.advanced: Nuanced everyday or cultural situations with varied clause structures, idioms, and precise vocabulary.

ja.beginner: Short, concrete scenes using common words, basic particles, and simple polite forms; keep kanji limited and provide readings.
ja.intermediate: Familiar situations with connected sentences, common kanji with readings, and a mix of polite and plain forms where natural.
ja.advanced: Nuanced situations with varied sentence patterns, natural register choices, and broader kanji and vocabulary; provide readings for kanji.

ru.beginner: Short, concrete scenes with common Cyrillic words and simple sentence patterns; avoid Latin transliteration.
ru.intermediate: Familiar situations with connected sentences and common case and verb forms; use Cyrillic without transliteration.
ru.advanced: Nuanced situations with varied clause patterns, aspect and case choices, and precise vocabulary; use Cyrillic without transliteration.

es-CL.beginner: Short, concrete scenes with familiar words and simple present-tense sentences, using natural Spanish.
es-CL.intermediate: Everyday situations with connected sentences and common past forms, using natural Spanish.
es-CL.advanced: Nuanced situations with varied clause structures, idiomatic and broadly understandable Spanish, and precise vocabulary.

de.beginner: Familiar words and short everyday sentences, with help.
de.intermediate: Short everyday stories, with help for unfamiliar words.
de.advanced: Detailed stories, viewpoints, and implied meaning.

ja.beginner: I read kana; I need help with short sentences and kanji.
ja.intermediate: I follow everyday stories with readings for unfamiliar kanji.
ja.advanced: I follow detailed stories; unfamiliar kanji may need support.

ru.beginner: I read Cyrillic; I need help with short everyday sentences.
ru.intermediate: I follow everyday stories; unfamiliar words and endings may need help.
ru.advanced: Detailed stories, viewpoints, and implied meaning.

es-CL.beginner: Familiar words and short everyday sentences, with help.
es-CL.intermediate: Short everyday stories, with help for unfamiliar words.
es-CL.advanced: Detailed stories, viewpoints, and implied meaning.

levels.label: A1 (Beginner)
levels.description: I can understand familiar names, everyday words and very simple sentences.
levels.guide: Use familiar concrete words, explicit subjects, one idea per clause and clear repetition. Preserve noun capitalization, umlauts and ß. Use correct case, agreement and verb placement.

levels.label: A2 (Elementary)
levels.description: I can understand short everyday texts and find information in notices, menus and messages.
levels.guide: Use frequent everyday vocabulary and connected simple clauses; explain unfamiliar words through context. Preserve noun capitalization, umlauts and ß. Use correct case, agreement and verb placement.

levels.label: B1 (Intermediate)
levels.description: I can follow connected stories about familiar situations, events and feelings.
levels.guide: Use connected narrative, common past forms, clear cause and effect and straightforward subordinate clauses. Preserve noun capitalization, umlauts and ß. Use correct case, agreement and verb placement.

levels.label: B2 (Upper intermediate)
levels.description: I can follow detailed stories and viewpoints, including some implied meaning.
levels.guide: Use varied clauses, precise everyday vocabulary and viewpoints; keep references and narrative connections clear. Preserve noun capitalization, umlauts and ß. Use correct case, agreement and verb placement.

levels.label: C1 (Advanced)
levels.description: I can understand complex stories, subtle attitudes and unfamiliar styles with occasional support.
levels.guide: Use nuanced vocabulary, flexible syntax and implied meaning; support uncommon or specialized expressions when useful. Preserve noun capitalization, umlauts and ß. Use correct case, agreement and verb placement.

levels.label: C2 (Proficient)
levels.description: I can understand demanding texts, including fine distinctions in style and meaning.
levels.guide: Use flexible, precise and sophisticated language appropriate to the narrative without gratuitous complexity. Preserve noun capitalization, umlauts and ß. Use correct case, agreement and verb placement.

levels.guide: Use familiar concrete words, explicit subjects, one idea per clause and clear repetition. Use correct case, aspect and agreement. Cyrillic only, without Latin transliteration or added stress marks.

levels.label: Basic (A2)
levels.description: I can understand short everyday texts and find information in notices, menus and messages.
levels.guide: Use frequent everyday vocabulary and connected simple clauses; explain unfamiliar words through context. Use correct case, aspect and agreement. Cyrillic only, without Latin transliteration or added stress marks.

levels.label: TORFL-I (B1)
levels.description: I can follow connected stories about familiar situations, events and feelings.
levels.guide: Use connected narrative, common past forms, clear cause and effect and straightforward subordinate clauses. Use correct case, aspect and agreement. Cyrillic only, without Latin transliteration or added stress marks.

levels.label: TORFL-II (B2)
levels.description: I can follow detailed stories and viewpoints, including some implied meaning.
levels.guide: Use varied clauses, precise everyday vocabulary and viewpoints; keep references and narrative connections clear. Use correct case, aspect and agreement. Cyrillic only, without Latin transliteration or added stress marks.

levels.label: TORFL-III (C1)
levels.description: I can understand complex stories, subtle attitudes and unfamiliar styles with occasional support.
levels.guide: Use nuanced vocabulary, flexible syntax and implied meaning; support uncommon or specialized expressions when useful. Use correct case, aspect and agreement. Cyrillic only, without Latin transliteration or added stress marks.

levels.label: N5
levels.description: I can understand simple everyday sentences in kana and basic kanji, with readings when needed.
levels.guide: Common concrete words, basic particles, simple polite or plain forms and clear short clauses. Canonical text omits readings. Provide contextual kana readings separately. No romaji.

levels.label: N4
levels.description: I can follow short texts about familiar everyday situations, with support for unfamiliar kanji.
levels.guide: Frequent everyday words, basic verb/adjective combinations and clearly connected everyday events. Canonical text omits readings. Provide contextual kana readings separately. No romaji.

levels.label: N3
levels.description: I can follow everyday stories and understand their main points and relationships between events.
levels.guide: Connected everyday narrative, common compound sentences and contextual support for less familiar expressions. Canonical text omits readings. Provide contextual kana readings separately. No romaji.

levels.label: N2
levels.description: I can follow detailed texts on varied topics and understand viewpoints and narrative intent.
levels.guide: Varied clause patterns and register, precise vocabulary and clear narrative cohesion; support specialized expressions. Canonical text omits readings. Provide contextual kana readings separately. No romaji.

levels.label: N1
levels.description: I can follow complex texts and understand subtle relationships, intentions and implied meaning.
levels.guide: Nuanced vocabulary, flexible clause patterns, shifts of viewpoint and implied meaning appropriate to the story. Canonical text omits readings. Provide contextual kana readings separately. No romaji.

scene.label: Scene
scene.description: One focused event with a natural stopping point.

chapter.label: Chapter
chapter.description: Several connected events with room for development.
